column2: I must sacrifice myself completely for my family; my worth is tied to being a 'perfect mother' who is strong, patient, and a source of peace; my whole world depends on me

If I prioritize myself, I am neglecting my sacred role; Mental health struggles mean I'm failing spiritually and in my duties to Allah; If I am not strong/patient, I am failing my children/home; A good Muslim is steadfast and patient
Suppressing emotions, relying solely on religious practices, isolating further, attempting self-soothing (humming songs), enduring silently, trying to be patient

I'm a bad mother; No one understands; I must endure silently; I should be doing more; My faith is weak; I will lose control/don't know what will happen; I am failing; I am not strong enough; I can't manage; I can't escape this/it will never end; My mind is always racing; I should be doing something, always
Loneliness, guilt, irritability, anxiety, shame, fear, feeling suffocated, heavy, churning, on the edge, confusion, frustration
Self-neglect, withdrawal, short-tempered reactions (snapping/shouting), brief social engagement, attempting self-care (humming songs), constantly trying to hold it together
